answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 91 POA, forfeited in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 15 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 91 POA on a stranger, so a farm must buy 619 sponsors, each risking real money. What carries the jade here is verification, the yarrow of cost is what stops the farm, and the lotus of the record keeps every claim checkable.
